Hello!

I'm the_federalist and I successfully requested to assume moderator duties of this sub. I'm grateful to the admins for giving me this opportunity to serve the conservative community here at Voat!

I'll be slowly working out the rules of the sub over the next week or so but my vision for this sub is simple: to be a place for conservatives to come together and talk about conservatism and discuss current events from a conservative perspective. This is not a "debate" sub, meaning that this is not the place to come to put conservatives on the defensive. It also means that the links shared here shouldn't be here for the sake of disrespecting or antagonizing conservatives.

That said, I strongly believe that people from other ideological perspectives should be welcome here. Provided that dissenting views are respectfully presented and that everyone--and I do mean that literally--engages each other with civility and respect, dissent is welcome here. I don't believe it is right or fair for me to ban a person simply for expressing views that are not considered "conservative." Trolling and attacks on users here will result in consequences, though.

Simply put: this is our conservative resort here on Voat, your conservative Fantasy Island. Conservatives, as masters of the house, please try to be hospitable hosts to others. Those of you who are not conservatives, please consider yourselves guests here. And all of us should conduct ourselves according to the ethics that go along with these roles.

I'll continue to refine these ideas. If you have suggestions for me please reply to this thread or send me a message.

Thanks!

EDIT: I forgot to add that since this site isn't hosted in the United States, I don't want this sub to be limited to American conservatism. Feel free to submit links related to things happening across the globe or to political parties in other countries associated with social and/or fiscal conservatism.
